meta.name: update-nanoclaw
meta.description: Efficiently bring upstream NanoClaw updates into a customized install, with preview, selective cherry-pick, and low token usage.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预览上游更新,挑选合入定制安装
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果维护着定制版NanoClaw,想便捷同步官方更新
copy.tagline_en: Preview upstream updates and cherry-pick them into your customized install
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a customized NanoClaw and want to sync official updates

howto.what: 运行 `/update-nanoclaw` 后,Claude 会检查工作区是否干净并备份,预览上游改动并分类,让你选择全部合并或挑选提交,解决冲突,跑构建与测试,最后提示破坏性变更。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 里运行 `/update-nanoclaw` 命令时触发。

say.text: 运行 /update-nanoclaw,把上游更新合进来。
say.note: 会先备份和预览,再让你选更新方式。

say.text: 先运行 /update-nanoclaw 看看有什么改动,别真更新。
say.note: 预览后选择 Abort 即可不改动。

howto.what_en: Running `/update-nanoclaw` merges upstream changes into a customized NanoClaw: preflight check, backup, preview, full merge or cherry-pick, conflict resolution, build/test validation, breaking-change warnings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when `/update-nanoclaw` is run in Claude Code.

say_en.text: Run /update-nanoclaw to pull in upstream updates.
say_en.note: It backs up and previews before merging.
It lists commits for you to choose.
